text_block_list.text:
This happened a little while ago. We had invited a designer,
and were discussing the direction for Espoir City's racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway... as long as it looks tough, I'm happy!!
I wanna make it a totally badass racing outfit!!"

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
"Strength"...
In that case, shall we start thinking of a "theme" to express that strength?

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
"Sporty"! "Growth"! "Hope"!
Or maybe "Wind" to emphasize a breezy freshness... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...'Sporty'? ...'Breeze'?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No, when I say wind, I don't mean a gentle breeze!
Hit 'em harder! Like, *RUUUUMBLE*!
choice_data_list: Like a cyclone or a typhoon or something?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Is that closer?
I mean, to put it even better—it's that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Super flashy earrings! A choker!
Throw in some leather and snakeskin patterns too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And, of course—metal accessories!!
Heheh, you've gotta have tons of clinking bling, right?!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
!? In a typhoon... yet clattering!?
I see... hmm, I see!?
choice_data_list: Umm... in other words, an intense vibe?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huuuh? Having it summed up like that
kind of rubs me the wrong way...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just about being fierce!
I'm strong, I never lose... and nobody looks down on me!"

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
"...S-So then... taking all of that into account,
what would roughly be the 'theme'—?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...'Ready for a fight'каз!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...'The Strongest'!
Her passion was palpable, but a clear, inspiring design direction just wouldn't come together. And so, time simply ticked away...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah—! Why aren't you getting it?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like... come on... Argh, dammit!
Do you guys even care about winning!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Ugh, I don't care anymore!!

I chased after her when she ran out.
After searching for a while, I found her
standing alone on the academy rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Please, let me talk to you once more.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...It's useless!
No matter what I say, you won't get it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-I told you, I'm making it by myself!
I'm the only one who's gonna wear this racing outfit anyway!
choice_data_list: That winning outfit is precious to me, too!
This racing outfit is precious to me too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Still... it's not getting through to them at all, is it?
choice_data_list: I'll stay with you for as many hours as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ... ...Then tell me this.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: To me, a Racewear is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Wait! Why the heck am I
the only one talking so desperately again?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I've been explainin' this the whole damn time!!
It's about time you get the picture already!"

I chased after her this far and finally managed to get her talking again.
I thought she'd finally opened up to me, but...!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text: S-So that was it! Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What's this all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text: I won't yield! I won't give in! I want to be strong!!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text:
"You kept crying it out from the bottom of your heart...
The true 'theme' that belongs in your racing outfit!"

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text: In short, the 'theme' of your racing outfit is—

text_block_list.name: Racewear Designer
text_block_list.text: "Defiance"!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Rebellion. ...Rebel, lion...

I wondered what would come of it back then, but...
she still wears her racing outfit for me,
even while grumbling about it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey. I'm done adjusting your racing suit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I tried it on, seems fine to me—
...What? Whaddya starin' at?"
choice_data_list: I was just thinking about how well you take care of it.
Let's keep winning in that outfit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!
I-It's not like... I care about these clothes at all!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Hell yeah, damn right!
